answer.says: Ramesh, the state of things is such that I cannot produce the sum you require at this moment. My means are limited, and the institution that should support me has not yet regularized my position. I ask you to continue keeping the house in order. I will do my utmost to settle the debt as soon as the funds are available, but I must be honest: I have only a small amount on me today. I am hungry, and I rely on your continued effort.
answer.thought: The tension between my hunger and my inability to pay is the friction of civil society where the universal (the state's obligation to me) has not yet actualized itself in the particular (my pocket). I must manage this delay with dignity, or the master-servant relationship collapses into mere force.
